title: As training camps prepare to open, NFL Network remains off of Comcast Xfinity

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: As training camps prepare to open, NFL Network remains off of Comcast Xfinity
sources.description: The lingering dispute between NFL Network and Comcast Xfinity won't hit full boil until Week 1, when Xfinity customers won't have access to NFL RedZone.
